summary: Sprint 3 (Shot List + Sprint-2 finish) verified end-to-end on seeded project c73286507b42. BACKEND pytest: 29/34 PASSED. All 5 failures are pre-existing TestGeneration tests hitting Cloudflare edge 502 (~60s) on POST /generate — this is a preview-env infra limit (real AI takes >60s, origin actually completes per backend logs), NOT a regression and NOT in this sprint's scope. In-scope suites: TestImageProvider 2/2, TestFrames 4/4 (full frame lifecycle: generate v1 → regenerate v2 → generate v3, versions 1,2,3 sorted, set active back to v1, status endpoint = Completed, delete active reassigns, delete-all clears active, unknown-scene/frame 404, delete-unknown idempotent), TestPersistence 1/1 (scene.frames + scene.comment_list survive PUT autosave with all other scene fields intact). Fixed the broken pytest.f_* module-attribute pattern under xdist loadscope by moving shared state into a class-scoped `frame_test_ctx` fixture and using the pre-seeded project (skips /generate entirely, avoiding the 502). FRONTEND E2E (390x844) on Solstice Perfume (8 scenes): (1) Shot List renders Production Summary — Total Shots 8, Locations 8, Lenses Used 5, Movements Used 5, Avg Shot Duration 4s, Longest Scene 8, Shortest Scene 7, Est. Wrap Time 6.8 hrs, Completion 0% — plus Lenses foot ('85mm, 35mm, 100mm, 65mm, 40mm'). (2) Each scene group shows 'Add shot' (add-shot-{n}) and one primary shot card (shot-{n}A). (3) shot-toggle-1A expands: shooting-order field (shot-shooting-1A), 5 status chips (shot-status-1A-Draft/Ready/Approved/Shot/Needs Review), 7 checklist toggles (shot-check-1A-camera/lens/lighting/audio/talent/location/props), shot-dup-1A, shot-open-1A. Storyboard Order is locked (shows '1 · narrative'); Shooting Order is an editable TextInput. (4) TWO-WAY SYNC verified at the data layer: editing shot-field-1A-description='SYNC_TEST_desc_v1' persisted to scene.visual_description via autosave PUT (confirmed by direct GET /api/projects/{pid}). (5) SECONDARY isolation: adding 1B via add-shot-1 renders shot-1B; editing shot-field-1B-lens does NOT mutate scene.focal_length (scene remained 85mm). Deleting 1B via shot-del-1B restored to 1 shot. (6) FRAMES on Storyboard scene 1 (mock provider): frame-generate-1 succeeded and created a v1 with SIMULATED SVG data-URI; frame-regenerate-1 produced v2 (frame-v-1-2 chip appeared); frame-remove-1 cleared. Backend GET /api/image-provider → {provider:'mock',configured:true} (verified in pytest). (7) COMMENTS on Storyboard scene 1: comment-input-1 + comment-add-1 → comment renders with author 'sb_1785767871', timestamp 'Aug 3, 03:52 PM', 'Open' badge, and Resolve/Edit/Delete actions. (8) PDF exports triggered without JS error — sl-pdf, sl-excel, sl-csv, sl-print (Shot List toolbar) all click OK; tb-pdf (Storyboard toolbar) clicks OK; export-pdf (Exports tab) clicks OK. Seeded project fully reverted to pristine state at run end (0 leftover frames, 0 TEST comments, scene 1 shots cleared, visual_description restored). Non-blocking web-console warnings (unchanged from prior iterations): 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation notices from react-native-web — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: ShotList.tsx: Data model is elegant — SHARED map declares scene<->shot field aliasing; primary-shot edits write directly to scene props via `commitScene(scene.id, { [SHARED[key]]: value, shots })`, secondary-shot edits write to `shot.data[key]`. Read path `getVal` prefers scene field for primary shots and shot.data override → scene for secondary. This gives the requested two-way sync with NO data duplication. Verified live.
ShotList.tsx: Field debounces via 450ms timeout with focus/blur guards; commit-on-blur ensures no lost writes. Good pattern.

rca_of_issue: test_frames_and_comments.py previous `pytest.f_pid`/`pytest.f_sid`/`pytest.f_v1_id` module-attribute pattern broke under xdist --dist loadscope: even though loadscope pins a class to ONE worker, the tests inside TestFrames were failing because (a) they also relied on state set by an earlier module-level test that ran on a different worker, and (b) the setter test was itself failing due to /generate 502s so the attributes were never set. FIX: rewrote to (1) class-scoped `frame_test_ctx` fixture that carries dict state between tests inside the same class (guaranteed same worker under loadscope), and (2) use the pre-seeded project c73286507b42 instead of calling POST /generate, eliminating the /generate 502 as a source of flakiness. Also added explicit cleanup of any frames or comments the tests create.
